summary: Completed comprehensive testing of A&E Hospital Wait Times app. All core functionality working perfectly including homepage, search, admin dashboard, authentication, and user experience flows.
passed_tests: Backend API connectivity and all 21 endpoints working
Homepage loads with hero section and 30 hospital cards
Postcode search functionality (SW1A 1AA and M1 1AA tested)
Sort by wait time button functionality
Admin login with admin@ae-wait.com / Admin123! credentials
Admin dashboard with all tabs (pending hospitals, all hospitals, users)
Admin can override wait times successfully
Wait time display shows 'No data' for hospitals without updates
Sign up flow navigates to register page with PayPal integration
Non-authenticated users see sign-up prompts and blurred wait times
Hospital submission functionality for authenticated users
Responsive design and NHS blue theme implementation
